import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_apportionment_2020.xlsx', sheet_name='Table 1', header=None)
header_idx = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.contains('STATE', case=False, na=False)].index[0]
df_data = df.iloc[header_idx + 1:].copy()
df_data = df_data[~df_data.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.contains('TOTAL|Footnotes', case=False, na=False)].dropna(subset=[0, 1])
row = df_data[df_data.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'California']
result = int(row.iloc[0, 1])

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_apportionment_2020.xlsx', sheet_name='Table 1', header=None)
header_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'STATE'].index[0]
data = df.iloc[header_idx + 1:].copy()
data = data[data[0].notna() & ~data[0].astype(str).str.startswith(('TOTAL', 'Footnotes'))]
data[3] = pd.to_numeric(data[3])
result = data[data[3] >= 2][0].iloc[0]
